# Popular Science

> > Popular Science delivers science news, technology stories, gear reviews, and DIY guides covering innovations, health, environment, and consumer products since 1872.

Popular Science is a leading science and technology publication offering breaking news, expert product reviews, hands-on DIY guides, and feature stories on innovations and discoveries. The site serves millions of readers seeking to understand how science and technology shape everyday life.

## Key Topics

- Science News
- Technology Stories
- Gear Reviews
- Product Recommendations
- DIY Projects
- Innovations
- Sustainable Fashion
- Wildlife Photography
- Health & Wellness
- Paleontology
- Electric Bikes
- Audio Equipment
- Houseplants
- Physical Therapy
- Best of 2025

## Core Content & Home

- [Popular Science | Science and Technology Stories Since 1872](https://www.popsci.com): Homepage featuring science news, tech stories, gear reviews, and DIY projects
- [Learn something new every day with the Popular Science newsletters | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/email-signup): Newsletter signup for science and technology content with 280,000+ subscribers
- [Popular Science](https://store.popsci.com): Official Popular Science merchandise store and shop

## Awards & Best Of

- [The 50 greatest innovations of 2025 | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/gear/best-of-whats-new-2025): 38th annual Best of What's New awards highlighting top innovations from 2025

## Gear Reviews & Product News

- [Meze Audio ASTRU IEM review: A polished step up for listeners who value warmth and control | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/gear/meze-audio-astru-flagship-titanium-single-dynamic-driver-in-ear-monitor-review): Product review of Meze Audio ASTRU in-ear monitors with dynamic driver technology
- [SUPER73 gives its California coastal cruiser an edit | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/gear/super73-a-series-new-sizing-platform-coastal-cruiser-commuter-ebike-product-news): Product news on SUPER73 A-Series electric bike with updated sizing and utility
- [Michael's is blowing out art supplies for up to 60% off during this end-of-season clearance sale | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/gear/michaels-art-supply-clearance-sale): Deal coverage for Michael's art supply clearance sale with paint and drawing supplies

## Science & Environment

- [Walmart and H&M are trying to turn carbon dioxide into clothes | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/technology/carbon-dioxide-clothes): Article on sustainable fashion startup converting CO2 into textiles for retailers
- [The biggest medieval march in English history never actually happened | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/science/battle-of-hastings-march-wrong): Article debunking historical misconception about Battle of Hastings and Bayeux Tapestry
- [What 'Jurassic Park' got wrong about venomous dinosaurs | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/science/venomous-dinosaurs-podcast): Podcast episode examining paleontology misconceptions in Jurassic Park films
- [14 silly, never-before-seen images from the Comedy Wildlife Photography Awards | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/environment/nikon-comedy-wildlife-photography-awards-outtakes-2025): Feature on funny wildlife photography from Nikon Comedy Wildlife Photography Awards

## Health & DIY Guides

- [7 hamstring stretches recommended by a physical therapist | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/health/hamstring-stretches-physical-therapist): Exercise guide with hamstring stretches recommended by physical therapist
- [How much light houseplants actually need | Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/diy/how-much-light-houseplants-actually-need): Guide explaining light requirements for common houseplants like monstera and ZZ plant
